root_cause: Escape key handler in listController.navigate clears the input value and emits a 'clear' event, causing loss of user-typed city when closing suggestions.
repair_strategy: Remove the lines that set ctx.input.value to empty and emit the clear event on Escape, keeping only the close(ctx) call to hide the suggestion list while preserving the input value.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion list without altering the input value, preserving keyboard operability and ensuring the user's entered city remains available for submission.
functional_risks: Removing the clear event may affect any custom listeners that rely on the 'clear' event triggered by Escape.
If other code expects the input to be emptied on Escape, they may need to adjust.
verification_requirements: Escape closes the suggestion list (aria-expanded false, list hidden).
Input value remains unchanged after Escape.
Focus returns to the city input.
Form data reflects the typed city after Escape.
ArrowDown and Enter selection still works as before.
